sentences.text_target: Tom wakes up early because he has a busy schedule today.
sentences.phonetic: /tɒm weɪks ʌp ˈɜːli bɪˈkɒz hiː hæz ə ˈbɪzi ˈʃedjuːl təˈdeɪ/
sentences.text_native: Tom se réveille tôt parce qu'il a un emploi du temps chargé aujourd'hui.

sentences.text_target: His daily routine always starts in the bedroom.
sentences.phonetic: /hɪz ˈdeɪli ruːˈtiːn ˈɔːlweɪz stɑːts ɪn ðə ˈbedruːm/
sentences.text_native: Sa routine quotidienne commence toujours dans la chambre.

sentences.text_target: He sees that his room is a little messy.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː siːz ðæt hɪz ruːm ɪz ə ˈlɪtl ˈmesi/
sentences.text_native: Il voit que sa chambre est un peu en désordre.

sentences.text_target: He decides to tidy everything before he leaves.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː dɪˈsaɪdz tuː ˈtaɪdi ˈevriθɪŋ bɪˈfɔː hiː liːvz/
sentences.text_native: Il décide de tout ranger avant de partir.

sentences.text_target: First, he opens the large wooden wardrobe.
sentences.phonetic: /fɜːst, hiː ˈəʊpənz ðə lɑːʒ ˈwʊdn ˈwɔːdrəʊb/
sentences.text_native: D'abord, il ouvre la grande armoire en bois.

sentences.text_target: He puts his clean clothes inside a small drawer.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː pʊts hɪz kliːn kləʊðz ɪnˈsaɪd ə smɔːl drɔː/
sentences.text_native: Il range ses vêtements propres dans un petit tiroir.

sentences.text_target: Then, he collects the dirty laundry from the floor.
sentences.phonetic: /ðen, hiː kəˈlekts ðə ˈdɜːti ˈlɔːndri frəm ðə flɔː/
sentences.text_native: Ensuite, il ramasse le linge sale par terre.

sentences.text_target: He places all the clothes into a plastic basket.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː ˈpleɪsɪz ɔːl ðə kləʊðz ˈɪntuː ə ˈplæstɪk ˈbɑːskɪt/
sentences.text_native: Il met tous les vêtements dans un panier en plastique.

sentences.text_target: He carries the basket down to the small laundry room.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː ˈkæriz ðə ˈbɑːskɪt daʊn tuː ðə smɔːl ˈlɔːndri ruːm/
sentences.text_native: Il descend le panier dans la petite buanderie.

sentences.text_target: He opens the washing machine and puts the clothes inside.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː ˈəʊpənz ðə ˈwɒʃɪŋ məˈʃiːn ænd pʊts ðə kləʊðz ɪnˈsaɪd/
sentences.text_native: Il ouvre la machine à laver et y met les vêtements.

sentences.text_target: He pours some liquid detergent into the special tray.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː pɔːz sʌm ˈlɪkwɪd dɪˈtɜːdʒənt ˈɪntuː ðə ˈspeʃəl treɪ/
sentences.text_native: Il verse un peu de lessive liquide dans le bac spécial.

sentences.text_target: He pushes the start button to begin the cycle.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː ˈpʊʃɪz ðə stɑːt ˈbʌtn tuː bɪˈɡɪn ðə ˈsaɪkl/
sentences.text_native: Il appuie sur le bouton de démarrage pour lancer le cycle.

sentences.text_target: After that, he walks back to the bright living room.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈɑːftə ðæt, hiː wɔːks bæk tuː ðə braɪt ˈlɪvɪŋ ruːm/
sentences.text_native: Après cela, il retourne dans le salon lumineux.

sentences.text_target: He takes a vacuum cleaner to clean the dirty carpet.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː teɪks ə ˈvækjuəm ˈkliːnə tuː kliːn ðə ˈdɜːti ˈkɑːpɪt/
sentences.text_native: Il prend un aspirateur pour nettoyer le tapis sale.

sentences.text_target: The machine makes a loud noise while working.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə məˈʃiːn meɪks ə laʊd nɔɪz waɪl ˈwɜːkɪŋ/
sentences.text_native: La machine fait beaucoup de bruit en fonctionnant.

sentences.text_target: When he finishes, he uses a soft cloth to remove dust.
sentences.phonetic: /wen hiː ˈfɪnɪʃɪz, hiː ˈjuːzɪz ə sɒft klɒθ tuː rɪˈmuːv dʌst/
sentences.text_native: Quand il a fini, il utilise un chiffon doux pour enlever la poussière.

sentences.text_target: He wipes the wooden shelf where he keeps green plants.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː waɪps ðə ˈwʊdn ʃelf weə hiː kiːps ɡriːn plɑːnts/
sentences.text_native: Il essuie l'étagère en bois où il garde des plantes vertes.

sentences.text_target: He remembers to give them some fresh water.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː rɪˈmembəz tuː ɡɪv ðem sʌm freʃ ˈwɔːtə/
sentences.text_native: Il pense à leur donner un peu d'eau fraîche.

sentences.text_target: Then he goes to the kitchen to check the sink.
sentences.phonetic: /ðen hiː ɡəʊz tuː ðə ˈkɪtʃən tuː tʃek ðə sɪŋk/
sentences.text_native: Ensuite, il va à la cuisine pour vérifier l'évier.

sentences.text_target: There are a few dirty plates left on the counter.
sentences.phonetic: /ðeə ɑː ə fjuː ˈdɜːti pleɪts left ɒn ðə ˈkaʊntə/
sentences.text_native: Il y a quelques assiettes sales sur le plan de travail.

sentences.text_target: He washes them carefully with a yellow sponge.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː ˈwɒʃɪz ðem ˈkeəfʊli wɪð ə ˈjeləʊ spʌndʒ/
sentences.text_native: Il les lave soigneusement avec une éponge jaune.

sentences.text_target: Suddenly, the doorbell rings loudly in the hallway.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈsʌdənli, ðə ˈdɔːbel rɪŋz ˈlaʊdli ɪn ðə ˈhɔːlweɪ/
sentences.text_native: Soudain, la sonnette retentit fort dans le couloir.

sentences.text_target: A delivery person is waiting outside with a heavy package.
sentences.phonetic: /ə dɪˈlɪvəri ˈpɜːsn ɪz ˈweɪtɪŋ ˌaʊtˈsaɪd wɪð ə ˈhevi ˈpækɪdʒ/
sentences.text_native: Un livreur attend dehors avec un colis lourd.

sentences.text_target: Tom signs the receipt and takes the box inside.
sentences.phonetic: /tɒm saɪnz ðə rɪˈsiːt ænd teɪks ðə bɒks ɪnˈsaɪd/
sentences.text_native: Tom signe le reçu et rentre le carton.

sentences.text_target: He puts the empty cardboard box near the garbage bin.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː pʊts ði ˈempti ˈkɑːdbɔːd bɒks nɪə ðə ˈɡɑːbɪdʒ bɪn/
sentences.text_native: Il met la boîte en carton vide près de la poubelle.

sentences.text_target: After a busy morning, he prepares a simple meal for lunch.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈɑːftə ə ˈbɪzi ˈmɔːnɪŋ, hiː prɪˈpeəz ə ˈsɪmpl miːl fɔː lʌntʃ/
sentences.text_native: Après une matinée chargée, il se prépare un repas simple pour le déjeuner.

sentences.text_target: In the evening, the apartment becomes quiet and peaceful.
sentences.phonetic: /ɪn ði ˈiːvnɪŋ, ði əˈpɑːtmənt bɪˈkʌmz ˈkwaɪət ænd ˈpiːsfʊl/
sentences.text_native: Le soir, l'appartement devient calme et paisible.

sentences.text_target: He lights a scented candle on the wooden coffee table.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː laɪts ə ˈsentɪd ˈkændl ɒn ðə ˈwʊdn ˈkɒfi ˈteɪbl/
sentences.text_native: Il allume une bougie parfumée sur la table basse en bois.

sentences.text_target: He sits comfortably on the sofa to relax.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː sɪts ˈkʌmfətəbli ɒn ðə ˈsəʊfə tuː rɪˈlæks/
sentences.text_native: Il s'assoit confortablement sur le canapé pour se détendre.

sentences.text_target: He enjoys his quiet home after such a long day.
sentences.phonetic: /hiː ɪnˈdʒɔɪz hɪz ˈkwaɪət həʊm ˈɑːftə sʌtʃ ə lɒŋ deɪ/
sentences.text_native: Il profite de son chez-soi calme après une si longue journée.
